subject: mental-agility-test
name: Mental Agility Test
exam: 3 hours, 200 single-best-answer MCQs with four options, 200 marks, 0.25 deducted per wrong answer, merit list from the 50th percentile | Zoology 40x1=40 | Botany 40x1=40 | Chemistry 50x1=50 | Physics 50x1=50 | Mental Agility Test 20x1=20

units.title: Verbal Reasoning
summary: Verbal reasoning carries 5 of the 20 MAT questions; the MEC sample is a direction walk.
Direction walks: track the facing direction, add east–west and north–south legs separately, and finish with Pythagoras; right = clockwise.
Morning shadows point west, evening shadows east; "facing" and "is from the start" are different questions.
Blood relations: draw the tree with squares (male), circles (female) and double lines (marriage); never assume gender.
Coding: write the code under the word, find the change letter by letter (shift, opposite letter with sum 27, reversal, pair swap, sum of positions).
Analogy: turn the first pair into a sentence and apply it; odd one out: find the property that splits the items exactly 3 : 1.
Ranking: N = L + R − 1. Around a table facing the centre, left is clockwise.
Syllogisms: draw the least the statements force; a conclusion follows only if no allowed drawing makes it false; use "either–or" for a complementary pair.

units.title: Numerical Reasoning
topics: Profit and loss, simple and compound interest
Time and work, speed, distance and time

sections.title: Profit and loss, simple and compound interest
Time and work, speed, distance and time

summary: Numerical reasoning carries 5 of the 20 MAT questions; the MEC sample is a successive-percentage (area) question: 15 % and 25 % give 43.75 %.
Two successive changes: a + b + ab/100; a price rise of r% needs a consumption cut of 100r/(100 + r) % to keep spending the same.
Profit and loss are on the cost price, discount on the marked price; multiply the factors (1.25 × 0.9) for mark-up then discount.
SI = PRT/100; CI from P(1 + R/100)^T; CI − SI for 2 years = P(R/100)^2.
Work: add rates (1/a + 1/b) or use LCM units; pipes that empty subtract.
Speed: × 5/18 for m/s; average speed is total distance ÷ total time; trains add lengths; opposite directions add speeds.
Ages: test the options; mixtures: the alligation cross; numbers: divisibility rules, HCF × LCM = product, unit-digit cycles.
Estimate when options are far apart; use the options to check size and last digit.

units.title: Logical Sequencing
topics: Patterns in grids and missing-number figures

sections.title: Patterns in grids and missing-number figures

summary: Logical sequencing carries 5 of the 20 MAT questions; the MEC sample (53, 53, 40, 40, 27, 27 → 14) is a series of repeated pairs falling by 13.
Write the differences first; then ratios; then squares, cubes and primes; then split the series into odd and even places.
A rule is right only when it fits every term; a wrong term spoils two differences.
Letters become numbers (A = 1 … Z = 26, EJOTY, opposite = 27 − n); repeating-letter series hide a short repeated block.
Grid and figure puzzles: find one operation from the complete rows and apply it to the incomplete one.
Calendar: odd days (year 1, leap year 2, 31-day month 3, 30-day month 2); century leap years must divide by 400.
Clock: θ = |30H − 5.5M|; the hands meet 22 times a day; mirror time = 11:60 − t.
